_map: 卷一's whole map (Hanli, 2026-10-05: 游戏只到卷一，地图和故事只限卷一): after the Foundation he may walk all of 卷一 — 石坳村 and 蒙山, the area round 沉鼎观, 泗水 and 彭城 (古三's county town), and the road north from 泗水北岸 to 漳水南岸 into 冀 — 邺城, 河伯祠, 漳渊 and 太行山口. It holds while 01-ji runs and after it ends, while 卷二 waits (`coming`, world.mjs mapOf). `say` refuses a place of 徐 or 冀 the map leaves out; `beyond` refuses a province of a 卷 not open — greyed on the map, the line said on a tap (world.mjs shutSay, rules/inkmap.mjs).

say.zh: 观主那张舆图上，没画这条路。
say.en: The abbot's map does not show that road.

beyond.zh: 观主那张舆图上，只画着徐、冀两州。别处的山水，图上是空的。
beyond.en: The abbot's map shows only Xu and Ji. Everywhere else, the paper is blank.

_title: The arc's own name, no number: the player is told the 回 (book.json via the scenes' `hui`, rules/hui.mjs); this stands only where a chapter has no 回.

summary.zh: 北上冀州。邺城年年给河伯娶妇；你把巫祝「送去报信」，漳水立了起来，冰夷的两条龙试了那个不跪的人。城楼塌了一角，压死了来拦船的老胡。破开洛书之封，第一鼎归来——柳树底下，站着太一宫的赵昂。
summary.en: North into Ji. Every year Ye gives the River Lord a bride; you "send the shaman to take word", the Zhang stands up, and Bingyi's two dragons test the one who would not kneel. A corner of the tower falls on Old Hu, who came to stop the boat. The Luo seal breaks, the first cauldron comes home — and under the willow stands Zhao Ang of the Taiyi Palace.

intro.zh: 筑基第二天夜里，观主摊开一张舆图：冀州，邺城，漳水边上，有件怪事——每年，都有人给河伯娶媳妇。
intro.en: The night after your Foundation, the abbot unrolls a map: Ji, the city of Ye, on the Zhang — something strange: every year, somebody marries the River Lord a wife.

mystery.zh: 邺城年年送下水的新娘，嫁的是谁？
mystery.en: Whom do the brides Ye sends into the water really marry?

_gate: No breakthrough here since 2026-09-30: the Foundation is laid on the 沉鼎观 cliff in 古九 (00-zhuji, gate 1); 冀 gives the first 鼎, 银月's second tail and her first memory.
_close: 卷一's last 回 ends here (01-end rest): 古十's 「完」 with 「卷一 · 沉鼎 · 完」 over it (rules/story.mjs closeOf `juan`), what this player did, and 卷二's opening as a teaser — only OUTLINE 卷二's 起 (太一宫来借鼎、下山为散修、阿禾追下山), nothing past it.

did.zh: 漳水立起的那一天，满岸的人都跪了，你没有跪
did.en: The day the Zhang stood up, the whole bank knelt, and you did not

did.zh: 冰夷的两条龙试过了你
第一口鼎，跟着你出了水
did.en: and the first cauldron came up out of the water with you

teaser.zh: 却说冀州鼎出水的消息，跑得比漳水还快。不出一月，太一宫便有人上了沉鼎山，说是来「借鼎」；观主为难了三天。第三天夜里，你背起爷爷那张打了补丁的弓，悄悄下了山——从此是个散修。他走到山脚，身后有人喘着气追上来：「利息还没还完，想跑？」要知后事如何，且听卷二分解。
teaser.en: Word that the Ji cauldron had come out of the water ran faster than the Zhang. Within a month men of the Taiyi Palace climbed the Sunken Cauldron Mountain, come, they said, to "borrow" it; the abbot was at a loss for three days. On the third night you shouldered your grandfather's patched bow and slipped down the mountain — a wandering cultivator from then on. At the foot of the hill someone came panting after you: "The interest isn't paid yet — running off?" What came next, Volume Two will tell.
